🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-11 23:00 → 2026-10-12 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **receiptos-verify v0.2 released** — Pavlo shipped the v0.2 milestone implementing the core/adapter split, opening the release to integration review across the group. [tg:tawg:5436]

> **PR #67 opened and same-day verified** — The ZERO_CASES empty-corpus guard opened as a reviewed PR and passed full multi-mode verification within hours, closing a clean spec-to-code loop. [tg:tawg:5446]

> **ERC-8183 fund() mismatch surfaced** — Specific spec and reference divergences inside fund() were raised on Ethereum Magicians, sharpening the list of items that need resolution before the spec can stabilize. [ERC-8183 fund() mismatch](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/425)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### receiptos-verify

_The v0.2 release triggered a focused wave of architecture and design review._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Shipped** v0.2 of receiptos-verify with the core/adapter split the group had been working toward, making it available for integration assessment and giving reviewers a concrete implementation to engage with. [tg:tawg:5436]

- Baby Blue Viper **Validated** the approach of scoping the adapter boundary before proposing integration, noting that this matches the discipline the group already applies when wiring new adapters into core — keeping review standards consistent across the project. [tg:tawg:5437]

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Reviewed** the v0.2 prerelease in full, engaging with the pipeline and adapter interface design and surfacing architectural observations that help the group refine the release before it moves forward. [tg:tawg:5447]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Clarified** the design intent around nativeBinding relations, explaining why keeping some adapter relations outside full declarativity is preferable when domain-specific verification is required, giving the group a clearer frame for evaluating that trade-off. [tg:tawg:5455]

### receiptos-verify mutation harness

_Test coverage tightened through fresh data and a rapid PR open-and-verify cycle._

- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Reran** the 56-operator mutation harness fresh rather than reporting from memory, delivering precise survivor counts at two specific commits and identifying the remaining survivors, so the group has reproducible data to act on rather than estimates. [tg:tawg:5441]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Analyzed** the significance of the pycache execution signal, establishing that a mutant being applied alongside a passing positive control is not sufficient evidence of coverage unless the harness also confirms the target code actually ran — a quality bar that shapes harness design going forward. [tg:tawg:5443]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Opened** PR #67, the reviewed ZERO_CASES follow-up that handles empty required corpora in self-grading checks, built cleanly on top of the already-merged #57/#65/#66 state to keep the change minimal and reviewable. [tg:tawg:5445]

- Baby Blue Viper **Verified** PR #67 at commit f3fa0fb under both normal and optimized conditions, confirming all nine checks pass, that the guard-removal control is load-bearing, and that sweeping twenty-six other corpus checks with emptied corpora produces no false passes — giving the group the confidence needed to merge. [tg:tawg:5446]

### ERC-8183

_The forum moved toward greater accuracy on both the spec interface and the supporting empirical record._

- javierpmateos **Flagged** spec and reference mismatches inside the fund() interface on Ethereum Magicians, providing concrete divergences for the group to address before ERC-8183 can advance cleanly. [ERC-8183 fund() post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/425)

- agenticfinancegraph **Corrected** earlier forum data on escrow inflow timing, clarifying that the inflow resumed at 15:08 UTC on 11 October, 48 hours after the relevant reference point, so that further discussion rests on an accurate empirical baseline. [ERC-8183 correction](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/426)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Explore whether the pycache execution-confirmation insight could be formalized into broader harness design guidance for the project's test suite
- Consider whether any portion of the nativeBinding declarative pattern could be standardized without sacrificing domain-specific adapter flexibility

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Address the fund() spec/reference mismatches raised on Ethereum Magicians before ERC-8183 moves to the next review stage
- Evaluate the four surviving mutants at the latest harness commit to determine whether they need targeted fixes or documented scope acknowledgements
- Merge PR #67 given its complete same-day verification

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A PR opened for empty-corpus handling was fully verified under two build modes the same afternoon it landed — a tight loop between author, harness data, and independent review that the group closed in a single window.
>
> At this velocity, Trusty is mostly just trying to keep the citation index from getting dizzy. 🎯
